title: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA)
details: The first of the Rashidun Caliphs and the closest companion of Prophet Muhammad (SAW). He was known for his unwavering truthfulness (As-Siddiq) and for being the first adult male to embrace Islam. During his caliphate, he stabilized the Islamic state after the Prophet's death.

title: Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA)
details: The second Rashidun Caliph, known as Al-Farooq (the one who distinguishes between right and wrong). His caliphate saw vast expansion of the Islamic empire and the establishment of many administrative systems. He was known for his justice and strength.

title: Uthman ibn Affan (RA)
details: The third Rashidun Caliph, known as Dhun-Nurayn (the one with two lights) because he married two of the Prophet's daughters. He was known for his generosity and for commissioning the official compilation of the Quran into a single codex.

title: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA)
details: The fourth Rashidun Caliph and the cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet (SAW). Known for his bravery, wisdom, and deep knowledge of Islam. He was among the first children to embrace Islam and is highly revered for his role in the early community.
